caption:
Mistral AI has secured a record-breaking 3 billion euros in its Series D funding round, marking the largest tech funding in Europe. The financing led by Samsung Electronics has propelled Mistral's valuation to over 21 billion euros just three years post-launch. Despite this success, Mistral's AI models lag behind competitors. 🤖💰

Can Mistral AI catch up with its rivals?

Sources: The Decoder, Mistral AI, EQT
